title: You Will Own Everything and Be Happy
html:
If you have signed in to Riftn lately, you will have seen it on the login screen, sitting over a stack of clips: You will own everything, and be happy.

It is a joke with a point. The line it flips started life in 2016, in a World Economic Forum video of predictions for 2030. One of them, adapted from an essay imagining life in a future city, read: "You'll own nothing. And you'll be happy." It was written as a thought experiment, not a policy. But it stuck, because it described something people already felt.

Klaus Schwab, founder of the World Economic Forum, at Davos in 2008. Photo: World Economic Forum.jpg), CC BY-SA 2.0.

Look at how most of us live online. You do not own the posts you made, you have a licence to them that the platform can revoke. You do not own your followers, you cannot export them or reach them without paying. You do not own your earnings rate, a formula you cannot see sets it and can change it overnight. You do not even own your account, it exists at the platform's discretion under terms you clicked through years ago.

For most of the internet, "you'll own nothing" is not a prediction. It is the current deal.

We built Riftn to offer the opposite deal, so we put the opposite sentence on the front door.

What "everything" actually means

A tagline is cheap. Here is what sits behind ours, in the product today.

Your content

Any post you upload can be minted on-chain to your wallet, the moment you publish or later. That record of ownership lives on the blockchain, not in our database, so it does not depend on us agreeing with you or even continuing to exist. It is the difference between a deed and a tenancy.

Minted uploads go further. Each one splits into 1,000 fractions, and you start out holding all of them. The ad revenue that post earns is shared across the fractions, so you can keep them and earn, or sell some to the fans who believed in the post early and let them earn alongside you. More in tokenised uploads explained.

Your content is yours, full stop. We may ask to reuse it to promote Riftn, a great clip in a trailer or a post on our socials, but that is permission you give, not rights you sign away. You decide, and if you change your mind you can take that permission back and we stop using it.

Your audience

On most platforms your followers are the platform's asset, rented back to you through an algorithm. On Riftn the feed is chronological, so the people who follow you actually see what you post, without you paying to reach them.

Subscriptions are on-chain and tradable. Someone who backed you early can sell their pass on if you blow up, and you earn a royalty on every resale. Your supporters hold something real, and the relationship is recorded somewhere neither of us can quietly delete. See tokenised subscriptions explained.

Your earnings

Tips go straight to your wallet, in the coin the fan paid with, with no swap and no platform sitting in the middle holding your money. You can set posts as pay-per-view or lock them to holders of a token.

On the money your own work brings in, pay-per-view, subscriptions and tips, you keep up to 99%. On top of that, Riftn shares ad revenue with creators, up to 90% for top-tier badge holders, and the rates are published rather than hidden in a formula. There is no follower threshold before you are allowed to earn. You get paid from your first view, not your first hundred thousand.

Your account

Your Riftn account is tied to a wallet you control. Sign in with Google, Apple, email or a phone number and the wallet is created for you in the background, with gas covered, so you never need to understand crypto to own your stuff. A login only ever opens the wallet that signed it, never an account someone matched to you by email.

And if you want out, you can deactivate or delete your account yourself, in a couple of taps. Owning something includes the right to walk away with it.

The network itself

This is the part people miss. Riftn is fully open source. Anyone can read the code, check our claims, or take it and build and host their own version. Nobody is locked in, including us.

In practice, you will not need to, because the users already decide what Riftn becomes. The requests page works like a prompt for the whole platform: ask for a feature or a fix and it gets built. Within reason, nothing is rejected. If something cannot work for everyone, it ships as a setting instead, so each person can shape the app around themselves. Bigger decisions go to the DAO, where $RIFT holders propose and vote on-chain.

Why build your own when everyone is building this one together? You are not just a user of the network, you are one of its owners, and one of its builders.

Why this is our tagline

We could have picked something safer. "The creator-first social network" would have been accurate and forgettable. We picked a line that makes people stop, because the problem it names is the whole reason Riftn exists.

Because the old deal keeps breaking people. Between 2017 and 2019, policy changes on the big platforms cut ad income for established creators by as much as 80%, sometimes over videos that had been up for years. Accounts with millions of followers have vanished overnight with no appeal that worked. None of those creators did anything wrong. They succeeded on ground they were only ever renting.

Because the happy part matters too. The original line sold not owning as freedom: less to worry about, less to carry. We think the opposite is true. The calm comes from knowing your work, your people and your money cannot be switched off by someone else's policy update. Ownership is what lets you stop worrying about the algorithm and just make things.

"Committed to improving the state of the world." Klaus Schwab at Davos, 2006. Photo: World Economic Forum, CC BY 2.5.

Because it is a promise we can be held to. "Own everything" is not a mood, it is checkable. The mint is on a public chain. The code is open. The revenue share is written down. The votes are recorded. If we ever drift from the line, anyone can show it, and we would rather be built that way than ask for trust.

Because it says what we are, in one breath. Rifting is the Earth's crust pulling apart to make new land. The internet's land has been owned by a handful of companies for twenty years. Riftn is new ground, and on new ground, the people who build on it should be the ones who own it.

Own something today

You do not have to quit anywhere to start. Keep your other accounts, they are still great for discovery. Just stop having exactly one home, and make the other one somewhere you own.

Sign up at riftn.com with Google, Apple, email or your phone. Post something. Mint it if you like. Turn on tips. Then the next time a platform changes its rules, it will be their problem, not yours.

You will own everything. And, we think, you will be happy.

Frequently asked questions

Where does "you'll own nothing and be happy" come from?

A 2016 World Economic Forum video of eight predictions for 2030, based on an essay by Danish politician Ida Auken imagining life in a future city. It was a thought experiment, not a WEF plan, but it became shorthand for a world where people rent everything and own little.

Klaus Schwab at the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting, 2011. Photo: World Economic Forum, CC BY-SA 2.0.

Do I need to understand crypto to own my stuff on Riftn?

No. Sign in with Google, Apple, email or SMS and a wallet is created for you, with gas covered. You only need to think about crypto when you want to, such as minting a post or moving earnings.

What happens to my content if Riftn disappears?

Anything you minted stays on-chain in your wallet. And because the code is open source, anyone can run their own version of Riftn, so neither your content nor the network depends on us.

Can Riftn use my posts in its marketing?

Only with your permission. We may reuse great posts to promote Riftn, but you decide, and you can take that permission back at any time.

What is $RIFT's role?

$RIFT is Riftn's token, and it brings everyone onto one token and one contract. Holders vote on proposals that shape Riftn, and you can use it to tip, unlock and pay for things in the app. If you hold DHB today, your balance comes with you: log in once to claim it after listing.
